algorithm: causal-SFT then on-policy clipped group-relative episodic financial policy gradient
validation: 2024 net growth at100000 INR, earliest tie; zero and supervised-only eligible
test_caveat: Retrospective evaluation repeatedly seen by project; method selection is adaptive, not untouched confirmation. Fixed universe has survivorship/selection limitations.
teacher_selection: Mean annual net log growth minus 0.1 drawdown, 2015-2023 only; 2024 not used for anchor selection
SFT: 768 causal random valid account states, two passes, label smoothing0.05, shuffled rows; no future-return targets
RL: Four60-session own-account trajectories per context, two contexts/update, three20-session decisions per episode; 128updates. Terminal net log growth minus0.1 drawdown. Group centered/std-scaled advantage with0.01floor; joint five-action probability ratio clipped0.8..1.2, two update passes, referenceKL0.01, entropy0.003, oldKL stop0.05. Reference is validation-selected supervised checkpoint.
sampling: Past-only up/down60session trend and high/low20session volatility buckets balanced; no future-regime sampling
execution: Whole shares, no shorts/leverage, next-open fills,0.10% fee+0.05%slippage each side;35%stock/60%sector caps with affordability relaxation; dividends creditedexdate; splits reconstructed; no tax/marketimpact model.
model: Pinned InternVL3-2B native attention and original-vocabulary LoRA rank16, no numerical replacement head; five conditionally independent categorical action slots, full account/stock input, neutral IDqueries with shuffled rows; greedy evaluation vs stochastic training mismatch explicitly retained.
selection_limit: No claim of optimum, flawless process, independent unseen test, journal acceptance or universal outperformance. RL gain must be measured separately from SFT.
